::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 70,259 people lived in County Roscommon, up 8.9% on 2016. It had the 21st largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 28% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Roscommon was €1,092, the 22nd highest of the 26 counties.
:::

## More about County Roscommon

- In 2024, disposable income per person in County Roscommon was €24,685, the second lowest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-income-map.html)
- In 2025, the average price paid for a home in County Roscommon was €230,300, the 23rd highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-prices-map.html)
- In 2025, 3.2 new homes were completed for every 1,000 people in County Roscommon, the second lowest rate of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-completions-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 21% of households in County Roscommon rented their home, the second lowest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-renting-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 19% of people living in County Roscommon were born outside Ireland, the 9th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/migration-born-abroad-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 42% of people aged 3 and over in County Roscommon said they could speak Irish, the 11th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/irish-language-speakers-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 29% of people at work in County Roscommon worked from home for at least part of the week, the 14th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-work-from-home-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 79% of people travelling to work in County Roscommon went by car, the second highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-car-to-work-map.html)
- Half of people in County Roscommon live more than 5.3 km by road from a GP, the furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-gp-map.html)
- Half of people in County Roscommon live more than 43.6 km by road from a hospital emergency department, the second furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-emergency-department-map.html)
- Forests and woodland covered 9.9% of County Roscommon in 2021, the 16th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/environment-forest-map.html)
